name: Sentinel Pack
description: Keyless Robinhood Chain (4663) monitoring for Aeon: address diffs, real usage of Aeon's v4 hooks, lookalike alerts for new Pons launches, one-shot Pons token checks, alerts when a watched deployer launches again, alerts when a Pons token graduates to a locked Uniswap v4 pool, and the busiest Pons bonding curves that DEX scanners cannot see yet. Read-only, never signs.
author: sentinelhood

skills.description: Watch Robinhood Chain addresses for balance, nonce and bytecode changes - keyless, read-only, block-stamped
Measure real usage of Aeon's Uniswap v4 hooks on Robinhood Chain: pools per hook and recent swaps, keyless from the official RPC
Alert when a new Pons v2 launch on Robinhood Chain copies your token's ticker or name, plus daily launch volume, repeated tickers and busiest deployers - keyless, read-only
One-shot check of any Robinhood Chain token: Pons v2 launch record, real trading cost, phase, the deployer's full launch history and holdings - keyless, read-only, block-stamped
Alert when a deployer you watch launches a new token on Pons v2 (Robinhood Chain), plus the busiest deployers of the day - watch by deployer or by any token they made, keyless, read-only

Alert when a Pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain graduates from its bonding curve to a locked Uniswap v4 pool, with the amount moved into the pool and the day's graduation rate - all tokens or only ones you watch, keyless, read-only

The most active Pons v2 bonding curves on Robinhood Chain in the last few hours - buys, sells, distinct traders, volume, net flow and progress toward graduation, for tokens DEX scanners cannot see yet - keyless, read-only
